newsitem.title: UK: EMS/Mark mixed on crosses, surges vs Swiss franc.
newsitem.headline: EMS/Mark mixed on crosses, surges vs Swiss franc.

text.p: 1415 GMT - Mark mixed on crosses, rockets against Swiss franc, makes up some lost ground against Swedish crown but rangebound vs French franc and lira.

* Dealers report U.S. buying of mark/Swiss behind cross' reversal from early low of 80.90 to high of 81.76. Spillover gains from dollar/Swiss surge above 1.50 for first time since December 1993 also cited.
* Mark sentiment remains weak amid prevailing view of a broad-based EMU starting in 1999.
* Bundesbank says after last council meeting before summer recess that it will pay special attention to developments in financial markets. No comments on current state of mark.
* Bundesbank keeps official rates at 2.50 pct (discount) and 4.50 pct (Lombard), sets next two weekly repo tenders at fixed, unchanged 3.00 percent.

* Analysts say decision to fix repo for just a fortnight and not over whole four-week recess likely to keep alive speculation about switch to variable rate. * Buba leaves M3 target corridor at 3.5 to 6.5 pct. * West German preliminary July CPI rises 0.5 pct m/m, up 1.8 pct y/y, slightly higher than expected.
* Mark/French franc at 3.3706/11, unchanged from late European trading on Wednesday.
* Mark/Swiss at 81.71/75, up from 81.28/38 at previous close and from 81.04 low on Wednesday.
* Mark/Swedish crown firmer at 4.2885/15 vs 4.2805/35 late Wednesday when it fell to lowest since Dec 1992 at 4.2795.
* Mark/lira at 971.85/95 vs 972.25/50. -- Astrid Zweynert London forex desk + 44 171 542 7792
